description: This file is a shell script used for testing git revision traversal, grafts, and path limiting functionalities. It sets up git repository states, creates commits, and verifies git's behavior under different configurations related to revision histories and grafts.

methods.name: check
methods.description: A helper function that runs 'git rev-list' with different options based on input parameters, compares the output to expected results, and checks revision listing with or without grafts and path limits.
